# Sales KPIs

`starter_target` values are starting points to calibrate against your own baseline after a few months of data. They are not industry benchmarks.

| ID | KPI | Category | Unit | Better when | Frequency | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| [SAL-KPI-003](#sal-kpi-003) | Meetings held | leading | count | higher | weekly | `sales-development-rep` |

<a id="sal-kpi-001"></a>

### SAL-KPI-001 Speed to lead

Time from an inbound lead arriving to the first meaningful human (or approved) response.

- **Formula:** median(first response timestamp − lead created timestamp) for inbound leads in the period
- **Unit:** minutes · **Better when:** lower · **Review:** weekly
- **Owner:** [`sales-development-rep`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#sales-development-rep)
- **Data source:** CRM lead created date and first logged activity
- **Starter target:** Within business hours, under 60 minutes; aim for under 15 once the process is stable
- **Pitfalls:** Auto-replies don't count as a response. Measure in business hours or report both.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-001](sops/SAL-SOP-001-lead-qualification.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-002"></a>

### SAL-KPI-002 Lead-to-opportunity conversion

Share of leads that become a Stage 1 Qualified opportunity.

- **Formula:** leads converted to opportunities ÷ leads worked × 100, by lead source
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`sales-development-rep`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#sales-development-rep)
- **Data source:** CRM lead status and opportunity created date
- **Pitfalls:** Rises artificially if weak leads are converted to hit the number. Pair with SAL-KPI-004.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-001](sops/SAL-SOP-001-lead-qualification.md), [SAL-SOP-002](sops/SAL-SOP-002-prospecting-and-outreach.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-003"></a>

### SAL-KPI-003 Meetings held

First meetings (discovery calls) that actually took place with a qualified contact.

- **Formula:** count of discovery meetings with status "held" in the period, per seller
- **Unit:** count · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** weekly
- **Owner:** [`sales-development-rep`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#sales-development-rep)
- **Data source:** Calendar and CRM meeting activities
- **Pitfalls:** Count held meetings, not booked ones. Track the no-show rate separately.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-001](sops/SAL-SOP-001-lead-qualification.md), [SAL-SOP-002](sops/SAL-SOP-002-prospecting-and-outreach.md), [SAL-SOP-003](sops/SAL-SOP-003-discovery-call.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-004"></a>

### SAL-KPI-004 Win rate

Share of closed opportunities that were won.

- **Formula:** closed won ÷ (closed won + closed lost) × 100, counting opportunities that reached Stage 2 or later
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`head-of-sales`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#head-of-sales)
- **Data source:** CRM closed opportunities
- **Pitfalls:** Leaving stale deals open instead of closing them lost inflates win rate. Enforce SAL-SOP-007.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-003](sops/SAL-SOP-003-discovery-call.md), [SAL-SOP-004](sops/SAL-SOP-004-proposal-and-quote.md), [SAL-SOP-007](sops/SAL-SOP-007-crm-data-hygiene.md), [SAL-SOP-008](sops/SAL-SOP-008-win-loss-review.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-005"></a>

### SAL-KPI-005 Average deal size

Average value of won deals.

- **Formula:** total value of closed won deals ÷ number of closed won deals
- **Unit:** currency · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`head-of-sales`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#head-of-sales)
- **Data source:** CRM closed won amounts (first-year contract value unless the business defines otherwise)
- **Pitfalls:** State which value is used (first-year, total contract, monthly recurring) and keep it consistent.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-004](sops/SAL-SOP-004-proposal-and-quote.md), [SAL-SOP-006](sops/SAL-SOP-006-closed-deal-handoff.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-006"></a>

### SAL-KPI-006 Sales cycle length

Time from opportunity creation to closed won.

- **Formula:** median(closed won date − opportunity created date) in days
- **Unit:** days · **Better when:** lower · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`head-of-sales`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#head-of-sales)
- **Data source:** CRM opportunity dates
- **Pitfalls:** Use the median, not the mean. One long enterprise deal distorts averages.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-003](sops/SAL-SOP-003-discovery-call.md), [SAL-SOP-004](sops/SAL-SOP-004-proposal-and-quote.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-007"></a>

### SAL-KPI-007 Pipeline coverage

How much open, qualified pipeline exists compared with the remaining target for the period.

- **Formula:** open pipeline value (Stage 2+) closing in the period ÷ remaining target for the period
- **Unit:** ratio · **Better when:** target · **Review:** weekly
- **Owner:** [`sales-manager`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#sales-manager)
- **Data source:** CRM open opportunities with close dates in the period; targets in business context
- **Starter target:** About 3× when win rate is near 33%. Set it to 1 ÷ your win rate.
- **Pitfalls:** Stale or unqualified deals make coverage look healthy. Count Stage 2+ only.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-005](sops/SAL-SOP-005-pipeline-review-and-forecast.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-008"></a>

### SAL-KPI-008 Forecast accuracy

How close the committed forecast at the start of the period was to the actual result.

- **Formula:** (1 − |actual closed won − forecast committed at period start| ÷ forecast committed) × 100
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`sales-manager`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#sales-manager)
- **Data source:** Forecast snapshots from SAL-SOP-005 and CRM closed won totals
- **Starter target:** Within ±10% of the commit
- **Pitfalls:** Take the snapshot at the same point each period, or the measure means nothing.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-005](sops/SAL-SOP-005-pipeline-review-and-forecast.md), [SAL-SOP-007](sops/SAL-SOP-007-crm-data-hygiene.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-009"></a>

### SAL-KPI-009 Pipeline velocity

Expected revenue the pipeline produces per day.

- **Formula:** (qualified opportunities × win rate × average deal size) ÷ sales cycle length in days
- **Unit:** currency · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`head-of-sales`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#head-of-sales)
- **Data source:** SAL-KPI-002, SAL-KPI-004, SAL-KPI-005, SAL-KPI-006
- **Pitfalls:** A diagnostic, not a target. Use it to see which of the four levers to pull.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-005](sops/SAL-SOP-005-pipeline-review-and-forecast.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-010"></a>

### SAL-KPI-010 Quota attainment

Closed won value as a share of each seller's target.

- **Formula:** closed won value ÷ quota × 100, per seller and for the team
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`head-of-sales`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#head-of-sales)
- **Data source:** CRM closed won; quotas in business context or the compensation plan
- **Pitfalls:** Look at the spread across sellers, not just the team total.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-005](sops/SAL-SOP-005-pipeline-review-and-forecast.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-011"></a>

### SAL-KPI-011 Outbound positive reply rate

Share of prospects contacted through outbound who replied with interest.

- **Formula:** prospects with a positive reply ÷ prospects contacted × 100, per sequence
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** weekly
- **Owner:** [`sales-development-rep`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#sales-development-rep)
- **Data source:** Email / sales engagement tool and CRM
- **Pitfalls:** Count positive replies only. Track bounce and opt-out rates as guardrails.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-002](sops/SAL-SOP-002-prospecting-and-outreach.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-012"></a>

### SAL-KPI-012 CRM data completeness

Share of open opportunities that have every required field filled and a next step dated in the future.

- **Formula:** open opportunities passing all SAL-SOP-007 checks ÷ open opportunities × 100
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** weekly
- **Owner:** [`sales-operations`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#sales-operations)
- **Data source:** CRM audit from the audit-crm-hygiene skill
- **Starter target:** 90% or more
- **Pitfalls:** Required fields filled with placeholders ("TBD", "1/1/2030") pass naive checks. The audit must catch them.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-003](sops/SAL-SOP-003-discovery-call.md), [SAL-SOP-007](sops/SAL-SOP-007-crm-data-hygiene.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-013"></a>

### SAL-KPI-013 Proposal win rate

Share of sent proposals that were won.

- **Formula:** closed won deals that reached Stage 4 ÷ closed deals that reached Stage 4 × 100
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`account-executive`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#account-executive)
- **Data source:** CRM stage history
- **Pitfalls:** A low rate often means proposals are sent before discovery is complete.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-004](sops/SAL-SOP-004-proposal-and-quote.md), [SAL-SOP-008](sops/SAL-SOP-008-win-loss-review.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-014"></a>

### SAL-KPI-014 Handoff completeness

Share of closed won deals handed to delivery with a complete handoff package within one business day.

- **Formula:** won deals with all SAL-SOP-006 checklist items done within 1 business day ÷ won deals × 100
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** monthly
- **Owner:** [`account-executive`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#account-executive)
- **Data source:** Handoff records and delivery team confirmation
- **Starter target:** 95% or more
- **Pitfalls:** Ask delivery to confirm. A handoff isn't complete because sales says so.
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-006](sops/SAL-SOP-006-closed-deal-handoff.md)

<a id="sal-kpi-015"></a>

### SAL-KPI-015 Win/loss review coverage

Share of significant closed deals that got a documented win/loss review.

- **Formula:** deals reviewed under SAL-SOP-008 ÷ deals meeting the review threshold × 100
- **Unit:** percent · **Better when:** higher · **Review:** quarterly
- **Owner:** [`head-of-sales`](../00-company-foundations/roles-directory.md#head-of-sales)
- **Data source:** Win/loss review records
- **Starter target:** 100% of losses above the review threshold, and a sample of wins
- **Used in:** [SAL-SOP-008](sops/SAL-SOP-008-win-loss-review.md)
